unit.frontage_notes: A narrow green pub frontage with a dark fascia reading THE RATTLIN' BOG, bottle displays, a bicycle mounted above the sign, Guinness signs and an Irish flag. valid_from records the first observed configuration in this archive, not when the unit was created or the pub opened.

business.name: The Rattlin' Bog
business.notes: The project owner confirms the pub had opened and was trading by the photograph on 2026-04-03. The owner reports that the pub's own Instagram announcement https://www.instagram.com/p/DR2P-oWiAl9/ gives an opening date of 2025-12-12. A separate London Pub Map post https://www.instagram.com/p/DZsqDWXkXsg/ reportedly places opening in December 2025. These posts and the supplied pub profile could not be independently retrieved on 2026-10-29, so the precise opening date is retained as a sourced owner report awaiting independent confirmation. No earlier name or historic occupant has been supplied. No multiple retail branches have been established; is_chain remains 0.

occupancy_notes: The Rattlin' Bog occupied this pub when photographed on 2026-04-03, as confirmed by the project owner. valid_from is the first observation in this archive, not an opening date. The owner reports a 2025-12-12 opening announcement from the pub's Instagram, supported at month level by a London Pub Map post. The opening date is recorded separately as a reported timeline event; no unphotographed historical observation is invented.
